# Planted bugs of the agent's organisation mode (scripts/go-mutants.sh
# client/agent/testdata/org_mutants.txt, make test-go-mutants, in make ci):
# each line "<mutant> | <file> | <exact line text> | <replacement> | <test>";
# the lines of one mutant are applied together and its test must then fail.
# Models: spec/proverif/e2ee_tcp.pv (downgrade-any-client, the checks'
# use) and nfltr spec/enrol/Enrol.tla (no-expiry-timer: NoExpiredSession;
# no-cut-on-update: RevocationBound). The checks themselves (chain, name,
# groups, CRL, NotAfter) are nfltr orgpki's, with its own mutants.
